transcript.text: Lincoln! I've been riding for a week handling depositions in Bloomington, trusting you to mind the office, and I come back to this! The Henderson deposition is gone — I cannot find it anywhere on your desk or mine. Judge Davis’s letter has been sitting here unopened for five days! You told me you’d keep things in order while I was away!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Ah, Mr. Herndon, I must admit the office does appear to be in a state of disarray upon your return. It seems that the Henderson deposition has indeed gone missing, and I regret to hear that Judge Davis’s letter has been neglected for several days. I had every intention of maintaining order in your absence, but it appears that some matters slipped through the cracks.

Let us work together to try to locate the missing deposition and attend to the unanswered correspondence promptly. It is crucial that we address these issues without delay to ensure that our clients’ needs are met and our professional responsibilities are fulfilled. I shall take responsibility for my oversights and assist in resolving these matters to the best of my ability.
